stages.name: First steps
stages.blurb: Chapter 1 — open the story and bank the one meditation that can be missed.

stages.name: The story
stages.blurb: Chapters 2–5 — every chapter and mission trophy pops on its own.

stages.name: Side missions
stages.blurb: Stranger chains — start them early, finish each strand's final mission.

stages.name: Activities
stages.blurb: Stunts, ranges, races, fishing, arcade, challenges — the open-world grind.

stages.name: Crime with your partner
stages.blurb: Vaults, trucks, shops and gang operations — bring a fast bike.

stages.name: Collectibles and the world
stages.blurb: Cards, WAiNK scans, vehicles, garages and money — sweep as you travel.

stages.name: Hidden and 100%
stages.blurb: The unconfirmed five, the profile trophies, then the gold for 100%.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own — no online play or DLC needed.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops the moment the last one lands.
No online play or DLC is needed — all 54 are single-player.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story trophy, impossible to miss.

steps.t: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end.
Story trophy — it pops on its own and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1, and do the balcony meditation before the chapter ends.

steps.t: Finish every mission in Chapter 1.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter; there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 — both characters become playable here.

steps.t: Finish every mission in Chapter 2.
Both characters become playable here — most of the list opens up from this chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 — a story trophy that pops on chapter completion.

steps.t: Finish every mission in Chapter 3.
Story trophy — automatic on chapter completion.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 — bank vaults open up after its optional mission.

steps.t: Finish every mission in Chapter 4.
Bank vaults open up after the optional Chapter 4 mission — see Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission, then keep playing in free-roam — sources differ on whether the finale is Chapter 5.

steps.t: Finish the final story mission.
Keep an untouched manual save from just before it; free-roam continues after the credits.
Sources disagree on wording: some guides call the finale Chapter 5 — both versions are shown.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run — a story trophy that pops on its own.

steps.t: Complete the mission Breakfast Run.
Story trophy — automatic on mission completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist — a story trophy that pops on its own.

steps.t: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.
Story trophy — automatic on mission completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play — a story trophy that pops on its own.

steps.t: Complete the mission Child's Play.
Story trophy — automatic on mission completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners — a story trophy that pops on its own.

steps.t: Complete the mission Headliners.
Story trophy — automatic on mission completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown — a story trophy that pops on its own.

steps.t: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.
Story trophy — automatic on mission completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory — a story trophy that pops on its own.

steps.t: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
Story trophy — automatic on mission completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist — the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient.

steps.t: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story ends.
The checklist is lenient — about 60% of true completion; most progress comes from other trophies.
Only 70 of 80 Challenges are needed, so skip the hardest ones.
Everything on the list stays available in free-roam after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — flying under bridges is reported as the quickest kind.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida.
Flying under bridges is reported as the quickest kind.
100% asks for 300, so the trophy lands first — track stunts under Progress > Activities.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — it pops on the way to the other activity trophies.

steps.t: Try each of the 9 activity types once.
Activities include shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and more.
It pops on the way to the other activity trophies — no separate grind.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges.

steps.t: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges.
Gold medals here are not too hard — steady aim beats speed.
Ranges are required in full for 100% too, so gold them as you go.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in total.

steps.t: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations.
There are 42 races in total; 100% wants all of them, the trophy wants one per spot.
Learn each course once, then race it clean — crashing costs more than caution.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40 — winning the same race twice does not count.

steps.t: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer.
Winning the same race twice does not count — vary the events.
100% wants 30 different wins, so keep racing past the trophy.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge — watch the line and reel in the gaps.

steps.t: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge.
Fishing is one of the 9 activity types — it also feeds Master of None.
Watch the line tension and reel in the gaps; rushing snaps the line.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish — any cabinet counts.

steps.t: Complete one arcade game from start to finish.
Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the game you finish fastest.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission — Andy is Lucia-only, start the chain early.

steps.t: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission.
Andy is Lucia-only — start the chain as soon as it unlocks.
One source warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave it late.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission — start the chain as soon as it appears.

steps.t: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission.
Start the chain as soon as it appears; one source reports story-linked windows.
The finale pops the trophy on completion.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission — it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

steps.t: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission.
Begin the chain early — the same single-source window warning applies.
Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands — only some strangers count, so check the name first.

steps.t: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida.
Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not.
Only some strangers qualify — check the strand name before investing hours.
Strands stay available after the story, so mop them up in cleanup.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission — separate from the Strangers & Freaks count.

steps.t: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission.
Start early; stranger chains may have story-linked windows.
Randy's finale is separate from the Strangers & Freaks count.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission — Tyrone is Jason-only.

steps.t: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission.
Tyrone is Jason-only — begin as soon as the chain unlocks.
Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot — 18 spots in 10 locations. The first one, in Chapter 1, is the only missable trophy in the game.

steps.t: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia.
Do the first one in Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and follow her to the balcony.
That first meditation is the only one reported missable — it disappears when Chapter 1 ends.
Sources disagree on the count: the trophy needs 18 spots, the 100% checklist 15 — both numbers are shown.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — which animal counts is still unconfirmed.

steps.t: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
Bret is Jason-only; his quests are also required in full for 100%.
Which animal counts is still unconfirmed — do not trust a single report.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — 100% wants all 15, so keep collecting past the trophy.

steps.t: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
100% wants all 15 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy.
Cards are scattered across Leonida — sweep a district at a time and tick them off here.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — scan everything new as you travel.

steps.t: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations.
Scanning also feeds the vehicle and location totals — scan everything new as you travel.
100% wants the same 100, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges — pick the easiest groups first, 100% wants 70.

steps.t: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges.
Challenges come in 8 groups of 10 — pick the easiest groups first.
100% wants 70, so the trophy is a milestone on the way, not the end.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner, then lose the heat — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works.

steps.t: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner, then lose the heat.
Bank vault robberies hand you 4 stars on their own — pair it with Maximum Withdrawal.
Both guides point to the train tunnel north of Ambrosia: cops struggle to follow on the tracks.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while staying wanted — the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third.

steps.t: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Stay wanted the whole time — losing the stars resets the chain.
The jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together; the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third.
If it does not pop, one guide says to rob a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan them with WAiNK, there is no need to drive them.

steps.t: Discover 100 vehicles.
Scan them with WAiNK — there is no need to drive them.
Scanning traffic near busy roads is the efficient route.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus — fill Focus first, use an assault rifle on gang members.

steps.t: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Fill Focus first — food, drinks or a shower at home, plus Adrenaline.
Use an assault rifle on gang members at their illegal operations; cops, soldiers and civilians do not count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — one guide reports stealing a docked passenger jet.

steps.t: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
One guide reports: steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away.
The easiest airliner is docked at terminals E3/E4.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — one guide reports stealing a tank from Mile Zero Air Station.

steps.t: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks.
One guide reports: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.
Expect heavy resistance — bring armour and a fast exit.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — back door, safe code, out unseen.

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Open the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and clear the safe unseen.
Go at a quiet hour and leave before the alarm cycle turns.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 Bank Vaults and escape — vaults open after the optional Chapter 4 mission.

steps.t: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — there are 8 in total.
Vaults open after the optional Chapter 4 mission; follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open.
Expect 4 stars on every vault — have a fast bike ready for the escape.
Chapter-gated: start the vault line in Chapter 4, not after the story.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape — hit it on a straight stretch, then break line of sight fast.

steps.t: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
Armored trucks run set routes — watch one, then hit it on a straight stretch.
Break line of sight fast after the grab; the escort calls it in quickly.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from every area, flying over the dark patches is quickest.

steps.t: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from every area.
Flying over the dark patches is reported as the quickest way to clear them.
Work district by district until the map is clear; the trophy pops with the last patch.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs — a second hit on the same gang does not count.

steps.t: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
One operation per gang — a second hit on the same gang does not count.
Gang operations also feed the 100% robbery totals.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — the exact trigger is still unconfirmed.

steps.t: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — the description is all the guides agree on.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — one guide thinks it means crashing out through the window.

steps.t: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
One guide thinks it means crashing a car out through a showroom window — unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the wording is unclear in the guides.

steps.t: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
The wording is unclear in the guides — play a full game and see what follows through means in practice.
Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also feeds Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — one guide reports maxing out Strength for both characters.

steps.t: A partnership with mass appeal.
One guide reports maxing out Strength for both characters — single source, unconfirmed.
Train Strength steadily through the story rather than grinding it at the end.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — one guide links it to 500 actions that change the Criminal Profile.

steps.t: Choices made, for better or worse.
One guide links it to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change it — single source.
Play naturally and check the profile often; avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — no guide has confirmed the trigger yet.

steps.t: Second time's the charm.
No guide has confirmed the trigger yet — the description hints at succeeding on a second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — one guide ties it to a strange event somewhere in Leonida.

steps.t: What the hell just happened?
One guide ties it to a strange event somewhere in Leonida — unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — the steps are unconfirmed.

steps.t: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
The steps are unconfirmed — the description points to knocking someone down from a moving vehicle with a melee attack.
Try it at low speed near a lone pedestrian, away from police.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills — launder through fences as you go.

steps.t: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
Launder through fences; one fence is reported to pay the most.
The total grows during the 100% robberies — it finishes on its own if you launder as you go.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — every purchase counts, weapons, clothes, food and cars.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
Every shop purchase counts — weapons, clothes, food and cars.
Spend as you play; a late lump sum on cars also clears it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app — the 4 story garages do not count.

steps.t: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total.
Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 altogether.
The 4 story garages do not count — only the 8 bought ones do.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — scan first with WAiNK, then register.

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Any 10 vehicles count — register each new find as you discover it.
Pairs with Whip It Good: scan first, then register.
